ListL3MountTarget.action: Fixed value for this API: ListL3MountTarget
ListL3MountTarget.maxKeys: Max number of mount targets to return; maximum and default is 1000 (values above 1000 or <= 0 are normalized to 1000)
ListL3MountTarget.marker: Returns results in lexicographic order by mountTargetId, starting from (and including) the specified marker
